hooks.command: if [ "${HERDR_ENV:-}" = 1 ]; then ( minute=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%MZ) || exit 0; printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"clock: %s (UTC, from date -u)"}}\n' "$minute" ) 2>/dev/null; fi; true

if [ "${HERDR_ENV:-}" = 1 ]; then ( minute=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%MZ) || exit 0; id=$(jq -ser 'if length == 1 then .[0].session_id else null end | select(type == "string") | gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]"; "") | select(length > 0)') || id=ppid-$PPID; stamp="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-${TMPDIR:-/tmp}}/herdr-clock-$id"; previous=$(cat "$stamp" 2>/dev/null) || previous=; [ "$previous" != "$minute" ] || exit 0; printf '%s\n' "$minute" >"$stamp" || exit 0; printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"clock: %s (UTC, from date -u)"}}\n' "$minute" ) 2>/dev/null; fi; true
